newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil closes up after choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil closes up after choppy trade.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed higher after drifting on covering and light liquidation, with news of Malaysian palm oil exports to Pakistan seen falling having some bearish impact.
India's STC offtake and soyoil gains overnight aided sentiment.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market held relatively steady, with interest seen in crude palm oil and RBD palm olein.

Some traders said news that Malaysia's export of palm oil to Pakistan are likely to fall in the coming months following the latest devaluation of the Pakistani rupee, which makes imports more expensive, also prompted some selling.
However, the extent of the reduction in imports would depend on the supply-demand situation in Pakistan, traders said.

"The imports depend on the supply-demand situation," a dealer said. "Right now there is sufficient stock in the country and the Pakistanis do not need to buy oil. So they don't have to worry about the devaluation."
The physical sector saw activities confine to crude palm oil and RBD palm olein, traders said.
Sep (south) crude palm oil was quoted sellers at 1,240 ringgit a tonne after trading at 1,225 and 1,230. Bids were at 1,230.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,230 with bids at 1,222.50. Sep (north) saw offers at 1,215 and bids at 1,205.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,240 ringgit with bids at 1,235. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,240 and bids at 1,235 and Nov (south) at 1,250 with bids at 1,240.
In refined products, Sep RBD palmoil was offered at $530 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $527.50. Oct was dealt at $527.50.
Sep RBD palm olein saw offers at $567.50, Oct at $560 and Nov/Dec at $550. Oct was traded from $565 to $560, and Nov/Dec at $550.
Sep RBD pam stearin was offered at $420 and Oct at $425. Oct/Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $345.
